sermon.title: Jesus Covers All, the New Covenant — August 4, 2024
sermon.speaker: Rita (guest speaker; not Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: The old covenant was a shadow, not the goal. In the new covenant God writes His laws on our hearts, is our God, lets all know Him, and remembers sins no more. Jesus is the guarantee of a better, final covenant, and nothing may be added; any other gospel is accursed.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The message comes first and the worship set after it. The worship leader says David was hunted by “another king Solomon”; left as said (Saul). The writer of Hebrews is attributed to Paul (“which we think is Paul”).

scriptures.text_nkjv: Oh, satisfy us early with Your mercy, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days! Make us glad according to the days in which You have afflicted us, The years in which we have seen evil.

For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the LORD: I will put My laws in their mind and write them on their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people. None of them shall teach his neighbor, and none his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ for all shall know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them. For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their lawless deeds I will remember no more.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then indeed, even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and the earthly sanctuary. For a tabernacle was prepared: the first part, in which was the lampstand, the table, and the showbread, which is called the sanctuary;

For the law, having a shadow of the good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with these same sacrifices, which they offer continually year by year, make those who approach perfect. scriptures.text_nkjv: Praise the LORD, all you Gentiles! Laud Him, all you peoples! For His merciful kindness is great toward us, And the truth of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD!

faqs.question: Should our days be sorrow?
faqs.answer: No; Jesus is the man of sorrows, not us.

faqs.question: Is there another covenant?
faqs.answer: No; the new covenant is also the last covenant.

faqs.question: Must Jews keep the rituals?
faqs.answer: No; that belittles the work Jesus did.

faqs.question: What does she wish she could give?
faqs.answer: God’s promises of joy, peace, hope, love and faithfulness, like a present.

faqs.question: What did God tell the testifier?
faqs.answer: Girl, you are done; call your sister, you’re going to church.

faqs.question: Is He here?
faqs.answer: Yes; when we gather He is in our midst.
